title: Example questions
replyTo: Paste them into the chat that made these cards.

cards.question: Rename the export function?
cards.context: The export helper in the settings module is called saveAll but it only writes a backup file.
cards.reason: The new name says what it does, and nothing outside the module calls it yet.

cards.question: What should an empty list show?
cards.context: The list page is blank when nothing has been added.
cards.reason: A short sentence is the smallest change and matches the other pages.

cards.question: Remove the old feature flag?
cards.reason: It has been on for every user since the last release and nothing reads it.
